operation_details.item: The user is lifelong lactose intolerant and avoids dairy milk, cheese, and cream.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How's the refactor going? I've been thinking about the module boundaries we discussed, and I believe we can simplify the interface quite a bit.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The refactor is moving along well. In parallel, I've been asked to plan a team lunch for the dev group, and I'm stuck on choices. Can you suggest meal options for a team lunch at my workplace?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Sure! Before I put together a list, are there any dietary restrictions or preferences I should account for? That will help me narrow it down.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I am lifelong lactose intolerant and avoid dairy milk, cheese, and cream in my diet. That's the main thing to keep in mind when we pick a place.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Thanks for telling me. I'll treat that as a dietary preference for planning purposes, not as a medical diagnosis. With that in mind, I'd lean toward places that offer grain bowls, grilled proteins, Thai or Indian curries made with coconut milk, or custom Mexican-style platters without cheese or sour cream.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Those sound practical. What if the team insists on the usual pizza and burger spot? A lot of people default to that around here.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Pizza and burgers can still work, but you'll want to check whether they have dairy-free cheese, lactose-free buns, or salads without cheese. I'd also confirm how they handle ingredients and prep surfaces, since cross-contamination in the kitchen can be an issue even if you order something dairy-free.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Good point. I'll add that to the catering request so the restaurant knows to be careful. I think I'll propose a Mediterranean spread with hummus, grilled chicken, falafel, and pita, plus a side of fresh fruit.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds like a solid, balanced option. Just double-check whether any of the sauces or spreads contain dairy, like garlic sauce or tzatziki. Many Mediterranean restaurants can substitute olive oil and lemon-based dressings instead.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Will do. I'll confirm the ingredients and cross-contamination details when I place the order. Thanks for helping me think through the logistics.
